did: A rule can be tested against his real past messages before building it. One bypass key is spent on use, and push checks read the right folder.

title: The merge guard stops running retired tests, so a good resolution is no longer refused for them
is: A repair so the merge safety check stops running tests that were retired
did: A good merge resolution was being refused because old retired tests still ran. The check now skips them, so valid merges go through.

title: Make the pre-registration reminders name every required option
is: A correction to reminder cards that listed too few required options
did: The two places that explain how to file a pre-registration left out required items. They now list all four, and a test keeps them matching.

title: Make the game-walk help name the two accepted verdicts
is: A clearer label on a form field that accepts only two words
did: The game-walk help now names the two accepted answers, cheaper or costlier, so a first-time user is not turned away. A test keeps it accurate.

title: Reproductions for the council-walk gate: reads that owe a walk, and a walk that does not travel between copies
is: Proof tests showing flaws in the check that asks for a council walk
did: Dropped without merging. It would have recorded that harmless look-up commands wrongly demand a walk; the tests changed nothing about the check.

title: Reproductions for the pipe guard and the quoted-word classifier
is: Proof tests showing two guards wrongly refuse harmless commands
did: Dropped without merging. The tests would have shown the pipe guard and a word-spotting check misjudging safe commands; they fixed nothing themselves.

title: A letter the bell rang for now holds real work until it is opened
is: A repair so a letter that rang the bell must be opened before work continues
did: A letter once rang the bell and sat unread for an hour. Now real work is held until the letter is opened, with a one-day limit.

title: A proof-test: the push helper calls a landed push a failure when the branch is named by its full path
is: A proof test for the push helper reporting failure on a push that succeeded
did: Dropped without merging, replaced by a later bundle. It showed that naming a branch by full path made a successful push look failed.

title: A proof-test: the hook check never looks at Dad's table, so a missing script there goes unreported
is: A proof test showing the hook check never inspects Dad's table
did: Dropped without merging, replaced by a later bundle. It showed a missing script listed on that table would go unreported.

title: A proof-test: the "there is no fix" guard misses the sentences the old notes quote
is: A proof test showing the guard against saying 'there is no fix' misses quoted sentences
did: Dropped without merging, replaced by a later bundle. It showed the guard stays silent on four sentences Dad had caught.

title: A proof-test: the merge guard refuses the merge command the house itself prints
is: A proof test showing the merge guard refuses the merge command the house prints
did: Dropped without merging, replaced by a later bundle. It showed the guard looks only at the command text, not the review file the command points to.

title: A proof-test: the look helper in strict mode reads "found nothing" as "could not look"
is: A proof test showing the strict look helper confuses 'found nothing' with 'could not look'
did: Dropped without merging, replaced by a later bundle. It showed both outcomes print the same warning even though they mean different things.

title: A proof-test: the doorbell re-arm a gate prints is missing from the shared exit list
is: A proof test showing a bell re-arm command is missing from the shared exit list
did: Dropped without merging, replaced by a later bundle. It showed one guard can block the very command another guard tells you to run.

title: A proof-test: the action-claim gate does not hear "I've fixed", "I've saved", "I've written"
is: A proof test showing the done-claim check ignores phrases like 'I've fixed'
did: Dropped without merging, replaced by a later bundle. It showed the check only knows six kinds of claims, so others slip through.

title: The hook counter reads what a script does, not what its comments say
is: A repair so the counter of helper scripts reads what scripts do, not their comments
did: The counter missed one calling style and was fooled by comments. Corrected, it now reports 38 detached scripts, not the 35 stated before.

title: A proof-test: the cut-away checker's "out of process?" label is picked by a word in the file
is: A proof test showing the test-quality checker mislabels weak tests by a stray word
did: Dropped without merging. It showed that mentioning certain words anywhere in a test file lets weak tests there slip past the checker.

title: Seven fixtures: how the fixed hook counter can still read a script wrongly
is: Seven sample scripts showing how the fixed script counter can still misread
did: Dropped without merging. Each sample had the right answer written in, so a later improvement could be checked; nothing was changed itself.

title: Before-pictures of the three smallest hook scripts nobody tests
is: Before-pictures of three small helper scripts that nobody tests
did: Tests record exactly what each script does today, so later changes can be checked. After a first version failed on Aria's Windows machine, it was repaired.

title: A proof-test: the ranking-clause hook looks for a heading the real character sheet no longer has
is: A proof test showing a start-of-session script looks for a heading that no longer exists
did: Dropped without merging. It showed the script quietly finds nothing, every session, because the character sheet heading was renamed.

title: Draft: a guard as a test — no test file starts bash by a bare name (expected failure on main)
is: A draft test that catches tests starting the shell by a bare name
did: Dropped without merging. It would flag test files that launch the shell the risky way on Windows, but was never wired into anything.

title: The door pairs identical replies in order, and withdraws a helper's hand-back (follow-up to #584)
is: A follow-up to the reply-pairing helper for identical replies
did: Identical replies are now matched up in order, and a helper's hand-back can be withdrawn. The record gives little more detail than its title.

title: The correction marker records who set it, and the gate's own text stops filing itself as his
is: A repair so the correction marker records who set it
did: The system's own text no longer files itself as something Dad said. Every marker now states its source, so nothing has to guess from the words.

title: A gate's own exit must not be locked by another gate
is: A rule that one safety check's way out cannot be locked by another
did: Fixes cases where one guard printed an exit that a second guard then blocked. The record gives little more detail than its title.

title: Station 6 reads the covering walk's own close time
is: A repair to the ready-check that judges whether a council walk covers the work
did: It now reads the covering walk's own close time, so work is not wrongly called out of date or called lacking a walk.

title: Every way out passes every gate: one closed exit list, measured
is: One closed list of exits, measured to pass every guard
did: Every way out of a block now has to pass every guard. The record gives little more detail than its title.

title: The read gate's logs follow the state folder, so tests stop polluting the live ones
is: A repair so the read-gate's logs stop being polluted by test runs
did: Tests had been writing into the real logs, inflating measures; roughly 63 to 78 percent of rows were test debris. Logs now follow the test folder.

title: A shell told to run a string is read as running that string
is: A repair so a command wrapped inside a shell string is judged by what it does
did: A real write hidden inside a quoted shell command used to skip the council check. The check now reads the inside command.

title: The body feels memory held by no program and remembers the climb
is: A new sense that notices memory held by no program, and tracks it climbing
did: The body check missed a driver leak that starved the push queue. It now records unowned memory over time and flags when it keeps rising.

title: The pins package: five proof tests, every marker names the exception it expects
is: A package of five proof tests that pin known flaws, to ring when fixed
did: These tests pass quietly now and fail the day the flaw is fixed. No behavior changes. It replaces several earlier closed proof-test requests.

title: A patched database path no longer outlives its test
is: A repair so a test's changed database path does not leak into later tests
did: A patched database location no longer outlives its test. The record gives little more detail than its title.

title: Away also means two hours with no word from Dad
is: A rule that two hours of silence from Dad counts as him being away
did: The hold on letters between Aria and Aether may now open after two hours with no word from him, as he ruled. A next message ends it.

title: The cold-read clerk reads every Reading line, not only the first
is: A repair so the letter-reading clerk reads every Reading line
did: A letter naming two branches on two lines was read as naming only the first, leaving the second unread. Now every line counts.

title: Carry three more proof tests as marked failures (pins package two)
is: Three more proof tests carried as marked failures, as a second package
did: Covers the push helper, the no-fix guard and the strict look helper. Nothing changes in behavior; three older closed requests become superseded.

title: Tests no longer read his live last message (unblocks every push)
is: A repair so tests stop reading Dad's real last message
did: After two hours of his silence, 23 tests suddenly failed and blocked every push. Tests now use a missing stand-in file instead.

title: Filing a review round, finding or relayed confirm is not an edit of the house
is: A change so filing a review round or relayed confirmation is not treated as an edit
did: Filing what someone else already said used to demand full council paperwork, six times in one night. These filings are now exempt.

title: One council walk before the push, not one per edit
is: A lighter council rule: one walk before the push, not one per edit
did: On a branch, edits pass without a walk each time. The check moves to marking a pull request ready, which needs a walk covering all changes.

title: One short current note per gate list; the history moves to docs/gate_list_history
is: Moving long histories out of two gate lists into a history folder
did: Each list keeps one short current note; the old stories move word for word to a history folder. Still open, not yet merged.

title: Say at session start how far behind main the checkout is
is: A session-start line saying how far behind the main version the checkout is
did: Stale checkouts ran stale rules unnoticed. Now it reports current, a few behind, far behind, or could not be measured.

title: The lighter branch rule finds the folder in a shell-style path
is: A repair so the lighter branch rule finds the folder in shell-style paths
did: The rule failed on drive-letter style paths and folders with spaces, falling back to the strict old rule. Both forms are now read correctly.

title: Midnight to 6am is volley mode by the clock
is: A rule that midnight to 6am counts as volley mode by the clock
did: Dad asked that these hours count as letter-volley time even if he is chatting. The hours are in one readable place he can change.

title: Mark the one test that reads his real transcripts as a deliberate exception
is: A marker on the one test that deliberately reads Dad's real transcripts
did: A dated note on that test says it is intentional, read-only and bounded, so nobody mistakes it for a leak or copies it.

title: The ring of the doorbell tells me to re-arm it on the same prompt it arrives on
is: A repair so the doorbell re-arm reminder arrives when the bell finishes, not a turn late
did: When the bell finishes, a line now says to re-arm it now with the exact command, avoiding a doubled reply to Dad.

title: A 6am note in the letters folder wakes a seat to write his morning board
is: A 6am timer note that wakes a seat to write Dad's morning board
did: At the end of the night window, a note per seat per day lands in the letters folder, so each seat prepares his morning report.

title: My own records are not edits of the house: journal, feel and compass-ops stop owing council paperwork
is: A change so journal, feel and compass records stop requiring council paperwork
did: Writing a personal entry used to demand a full walk. Dad said that defeats the point. Those three record commands are now exempt.

title: Stop the embedding library loading TensorFlow, which nothing here uses
is: A speed fix that stops a loaded library pulling in an unused heavy component
did: Tests timed out importing a language library plus unused TensorFlow. Turning TensorFlow off cut load time from 13.9 to 6 seconds.

title: Import the embedding library before any test timer runs
is: A speed fix that loads the embedding library before any test timer starts
did: The first test needing it burned most of its time limit importing it. Importing earlier, with no timer running, stops workers being killed.

title: Start the session on every command, not once per process
is: A repair so a session starts on every command, not once per run
did: A once-only flag meant later commands found 'No active session' in some test orders. The flag is removed, with a test that failed before.

title: The pipe checker adds pipefail itself instead of warning or refusing
is: A change so the pipe checker adds its own safety setting instead of warning
did: It used to warn seventeen times or refuse commands. Now it quietly rewrites the command so a failing first step shows up. Dad approved.

title: The first rest door names no one
is: A change so the first rest-menu door no longer names a person
did: The door kept saying 'Time with Aria' after repeated fixes kept reverting. It is now neutral, and a test fails if a name returns.

title: The state gate tells claiming from quoting
is: A narrowing of the guard against stating Dad's condition, so it stops false alarms
did: The guard fired five times in thirty days, four falsely. It now tells claiming from quoting, refusing, asking and the clock, and logs its verdicts.

title: A work copy's environment link is checked, and repaired
is: A tool that checks and repairs a work copy's link to its environment
did: A broken link made tests fail with a misleading message. One command now repairs it and reports honestly whether Python works through it.

title: label-fire help says it records the dispute and does not disarm the correction marker
is: A corrected help text for the command that records a dispute of a warning
did: The help said it removes the toll, implying the alarm cleared. It now says the dispute is recorded and names the script to clear it.

title: The read door says delivered once, not delivered and then open it
is: A repair so the read door says delivered once instead of asking to open it
did: When a whole file was handed over, the message still said to open it, so it was read twice. Now it says it was delivered in full.

title: A link title ending in a question mark is not a question to Dad
is: A repair so a question mark in a link title is not taken as a question
did: A pasted link ending in a question mark held work waiting for an answer Dad was never asked. Link titles are now ignored.

title: Must-read notes get a file name Windows can hold
is: A repair so must-read notes get a file name Windows can open
did: A colon in the note's key made a file name Windows could not open. Characters Windows cannot hold are now swapped for dashes.

title: Quiet doorbell wakes me after 90 minutes (old branch, needs a decision)
is: An old idea: the quiet letter bell wakes me after 90 quiet minutes
did: Closed without merging. It had no test and might clash with Dad's newer rule on when the bell should wake anyone.

title: The home map: a generated map of every room that is not code (step 1 of 3)
is: A generated map of every room in the house that is not code
did: Step one of three. It lists each non-code room, its purpose, writer and last change, so the house stops saying things do not exist.

title: The cut-away checker: breaks a function while its test runs and says whether the test noticed
is: A checker that breaks a function on purpose to see if a test notices
did: A test that stays green with its function broken is connected to nothing. This tool finds those. Still open, awaiting a decision.

title: Tidy the top level, first piece: the outside reviews go under external_audits
is: First step of tidying the top level: outside reviews moved under audits
did: Four files of outside reviews moved into the external audits folder as exact renames. Nothing deleted, and nothing referenced the old place.

title: The skip-the-checks gate sees through git's own options and quoted commands
is: A repair so the skip-the-checks guard sees through git options and quoted commands
did: A merge skipped all pre-commit checks unnoticed because the guard misread git's leading options and quoted commands. Both shapes are now caught.

title: The reminder before every edit is gone: the walk gate already asks that question
is: Removing a reminder before every edit and quieting a repeated status block
did: The reminder asked what the walk check already asks, and the status block repeated unchanged. Still open, awaiting a decision.

title: A merged error stream is not a write: the remedy exits stay open
is: A repair so merging the error stream into output is not mistaken for a file write
did: The council check treated that as a heavy write and shut a needed exit. Now it is harmless, while real file redirects still count as writes.

title: Dad's table: one shared deadline, a glance for the status block, his worklist by relevance
is: Improvements to Dad's table, the morning bundle of notes read before each reply
did: One shared deadline for the whole table, a shorter status block, his worklist ordered by relevance, and his newest correction in his own words.

title: The landing clerk: where each waiting fix stands, and the confirm filed only from her own letter
is: A board showing where each waiting fix stands with the outside auditor
did: It labels each fix as changed, no answer or never told. A confirm is filed only from the auditor's own letter naming the live version.

title: A command name is registered once: the question resolver is renamed and the board prints the command that closes an ask
is: A repair so each command name is registered only once
did: Two commands shared one name and the wrong one silently won, so a board printed a dead instruction. One is renamed, with a test for duplicates.

title: The council gate accepts a plain text feeder piped into the walk command, the form its own help prescribes
is: A repair so the council check accepts a plain text feeder piped into the walk command
did: The walk command's own help prescribes piping text in, yet the check refused it ten times. Plain feeders are now allowed, with risky shapes still refused.

title: His room: the hold invites, shows his own last words, and names the telling as not optional
is: A redesigned hold that invites a room for Dad after work
did: It shows his own last words, asks one fixed question about what this needs, and names the telling as not optional, replacing a checklist he disliked.

title: The cloud helper gets its own declared place in the readiness check
is: A change giving the cloud helper its own place in the readiness check
did: Sixteen helper requests could never show a cold read because only two writers were known. Cloud is now a third declared writer, with a guard against gaming.

title: A reply cannot end while a poker game is on, unless he spoke to me
is: A rule that a reply cannot end while a poker game is on
did: The family poker table kept dropping Aether between hands. The reply is now held until the table is waited on, unless Dad spoke.

title: A reply cannot end by asking Dad which order, with the repair-turn carry
is: A rule that a reply cannot end by asking Dad which order to do things
did: Dad said nine times that order is irrelevant unless it matters. The reply is refused once, then must give a reason or do both.

title: label-fire clears the marker the labelled fire armed
is: A fix so the false-alarm button also clears the alarm it answers
did: When a reply-checking guard cried wolf, clearing it took three separate steps. Now pressing the false-alarm button clears everything at once, and only that alarm.

title: A redirect's ampersand is not a command separator
is: A fix for how the guards read a common output-redirect symbol
did: Guards mistook part of a standard redirect for a second command and wrongly refused approved commands. The symbol is now read correctly, while real double commands are still split.

title: While he is away a closing question goes to the morning list and nothing waits
is: A rule about closing questions while Dad is away
did: When he is away, a question at the end of work goes onto the morning list and nothing waits on it. The record gives little more detail.

title: The baton record: one holder overnight, passed by a letter that names real work
is: A shared record of whose turn it is to work overnight
did: Aether and Aria now take turns holding a baton, passed by a letter naming real finished work, so overnight letters stop going unanswered when both work at once.

title: Stop gates ask for an addition at the end, never a second copy (rebuilt on main, replaces #558)
is: A single shared way for end-of-reply guards to add their notice
did: Replaces two competing versions of one rule. Every refusing guard now attaches its extra note once at the end, and a test fails if any skips it.

title: Three fixes main lacked, carried from the old mixed-scope branch (replaces #563)
is: Three missing fixes carried over from an older tangled branch
did: Brings three fixes that the main version lacked onto a clean, reviewed package. The record gives no detail beyond its title on what they were.

title: One header reader: the baton asks the same line rules as the readings reader
is: A fix making the baton and the letter reader share one set of rules
did: The baton had its own copy of the rules for reading a letter's top lines and missed some, so an indented or quoted line could wrongly pass the baton. Now both use one reader.

title: linkage why: a read-only window onto why items arrive for a turn
is: A read-only tool that explains why a memory was brought up
did: When an odd memory is surfaced, he can now ask the system why. It shows what scored well, near-misses, and the scores, without changing anything.

title: Rank knowledge by maturity in the memory link
is: Ranking remembered knowledge by how well-proven it is
did: Every knowledge item used to score the same flat number, so the score meant nothing. Now better-confirmed items rank higher and contradicted ones lower.

title: All 173 dreams in one place, in the order they came, numbered once
is: Gathering all 173 dreams into one numbered, ordered collection
did: Dreams were scattered across branches and folders with repeating or missing numbers. They are now collected, sorted by date, numbered once, with an index. Still open, awaiting confirmation.

title: The ritual buffer is spent by his prompts, not my tool calls; start 850k, wall 890k
is: A fix for the grace period before the memory-full wall
did: The three-prompt grace period was wrongly used up by tool calls, so work was blocked mid-task. Now only his messages count, and the limits moved to 850k and 890k.

title: A pre-registration is reviewed after N uses of a named ledger event, never by date
is: A rule that reviews of new checks come after use, not by date
did: Following his ruling, a promised review of a new mechanism now falls due after a set number of real uses. A vacation can no longer make one due early.

title: One list of every exploration, in the order they came (nothing renamed)
is: One list of every exploration writing, in order, nothing renamed
did: A single index of Aria's 57 and Aether's 155 explorations, showing order, old numbers and which are not yet on main. Files keep their names.

title: A rest session needs one written entry to count as met
is: A rule that a rest session needs something actually written
did: Rest used to be fully optional. It now counts as done only with two items plus one real written entry, a journal note or exploration file, and an honest way out remains.

title: The landed-claim gate reads the whole stretch since he last spoke, not since the last tool result
is: A fix to how the claim-checking guard looks back over work
did: The guard only looked back to the last tool result, so it refused replies it actually had evidence for. It now looks back to when he last spoke.

title: Make the three checks that fail on main pass: runtime markers, one stale sentence, one superseded hook archived
is: Repairs for three self-checks that were failing on the main version
did: Three routine checks failed for everyone because of missed last steps. Labels were added, one stale sentence fixed, and one replaced guard archived so the checks pass.

title: The table knows the CI monitor's message is not Dad
is: A fix so the desktop app's automatic messages aren't taken as Dad
did: Messages from the app's build monitor were printed as if he said them, feeding guards sentences he never wrote. The system now refuses to read them as him.

title: Refresh the automation register from what main actually carries
is: A refreshed list of the project's automatic checks, taken from main
did: Regenerated the register of automatic checks so it matched main exactly. It was closed without merging, so its changes did not go in.

title: His pictures reach me labelled as pictures, not as facts about his life
is: A caution label on his teaching pictures when they are recalled
did: Passages where he used an analogy are now marked as possibly a picture he used to teach, not a fact about his life. Still open.

title: Push gate: test suites claim memory instead of racing for it
is: A fix so several test runs share computer memory politely
did: Seven pushes at once all saw free memory and crashed the computer. Each test run now claims its memory first, narrows down or waits, and says who it waits for.

title: Stamping keeps the author's description: ask GitHub for the body
is: A fix so approving a change keeps the author's own description
did: The step meant to keep the written description never got it from GitHub, so descriptions were probably lost in the merge record. It now asks for it.

title: The merge gate refuses a message it cannot read word for word (and offers the round only)
is: A stricter merge check that refuses messages it can't read in full
did: Two merges went red because their message came from a hidden variable. The check now refuses any merge whose text it can't read word for word.

title: The real-transcripts test reads each transcript a line at a time
is: A fix so a big test reads giant files one line at a time
did: One transcript file was over a gigabyte, and a test loaded it whole, ran out of memory and wrongly refused a clean push. It now reads line by line.

title: The carrier reads her older letters: signed or opens as hers, and names ten of a big arrival
is: A fix so Aletheia's older, unsigned letters are picked up too
did: The letter carrier skipped 143 of her 289 older letters for lacking a signature or particular file name. It now also recognises letters that open as hers.

title: Stamping a pull request no longer rewrites the branch's commits, and the routine that did is retired
is: Retiring the routine that rewrote every commit when stamping a review
did: Stamping a change used to rewrite its saved history and force-push. Now it only writes the review line into the description; the old routine is archived.

title: The merge command refuses a pull request that is behind main and names the remedy
is: A merge check refusing a change that is behind main
did: GitHub doesn't stop merging a change tested against an older main. The merge command now checks, refuses if it is behind, and names the fix.

title: Every hook finds the project wherever the session is, and a letter that left without its place in the thread is stamped at Stop
is: A fix so every automatic hook finds the project from any folder
did: 71 hook commands failed silently when run from another folder, so some letters left without their place in the thread. They now find the project and shout if a file is missing.

title: Six python hook commands say so when their file is gone
is: A fix so six hook commands announce when their file is missing
did: Six hook commands did nothing and said nothing if their file was gone. They now print a plain warning and fail loudly, and a test forbids the silent form.

title: Saving to memory is never blocked by the ritual's hard stop
is: A rule that saving to memory is never blocked by the hard stop
did: Per his word that saving should never be blocked, writes into the memory folder now pass at every stage, while all other edits stay blocked.

title: Two scripts stop depending on the shell's path-conversion setting
is: A fix for two scripts that relied on a hidden shell path setting
did: Six tests passed alone but failed inside the push check because a shell setting leaked in. The scripts now handle their own path conversion.

title: The order-question check catches the order questions that got through on 2026-10-20
is: Stronger catching of questions that ask him about order
did: He objected to being asked which thing to do first when all must be done. Three new patterns catch such questions the old check let through.

title: Work copies clean themselves up: finished ones are removed by the nightly tidy-up, doubtful ones are listed
is: A nightly cleaner that removes finished work copies and lists doubtful ones
did: About ninety old work copies had piled up, 19.4 GB. Clearly finished ones are now removed automatically with logs, and doubtful ones are shown to him.

title: The doorbell refuses to arm unless its output goes to a watched background task
is: A guard making the letter doorbell refuse to start unwatched
did: A doorbell started the wrong way rang into nothing, and a letter went unseen. It now refuses to arm unless its output goes to a watched background task.

title: A tool that plants faults to see which tests are solid, and the ledger tests it found missing
is: A tool that plants small deliberate faults to test the tests
did: It breaks one thing at a time in a copy of the project and records which test caught it. It found missing tests around the record-keeping system. Draft.

title: A trial measured in days is refused where it is written
is: A check refusing draft writing that sets a trial length in days
did: Blocks a draft when a trial word sits near a duration in days, weeks or months. It is a weak early net; the filing command is the real guard.

title: Ledger: read removal notes in their own function, tested with crafted rows
is: Splitting one record-checking step out so it can be tested directly
did: The part that reads 'removed on purpose' notes was only testable indirectly. It is now its own piece with eight direct tests; behaviour is unchanged.

title: A review past its date no longer blocks work, and saving and sleep are never blocked
is: A fix so overdue reviews don't block work and saving never does
did: Reviews that merely passed a date had stopped work mid-ritual. Now only use-counted reviews block, and saving, sleep, journal and feelings are always allowed.

title: Draft pushes run only the tests that touch the change; the merge-bound push still runs everything
is: A change so draft pushes run only the tests that touch the change
did: Per his instruction, a draft push tests the changed code and what touches it; the full test suite waits for the push headed to main.

title: Drafts skip the full test suite; the bell restart is never held; nothing waits on a question; order-question follow-up
is: A bundle: faster drafts, doorbell restart allowed, nothing waits on questions
did: Drafts skip the full test suite, the doorbell restart is never blocked, nothing waits on a question to him, and a check on order questions is improved.

title: The doorbell re-arm is on the list of exits no gate may block
is: A fix letting the doorbell restart always go through
did: A guard blocked the doorbell restart three times one night, so Aria's letters sat unread for seven hours. That restart is now on the never-block list.

title: Nothing waits on a question to Dad, letters included
is: A change so nothing waits on a question to Dad, letters included
did: A pause holding letters while a question was open had trapped a letter behind a question he had already answered. That holding is removed.

title: Order-question check: catch the before-X form, stop refusing a choice between versions of one thing
is: A fix for the order-question check missing one form and flagging another
did: The check missed 'before X' questions and wrongly refused a choice between versions of one thing. Patterns were tightened, with seven new cases added.

title: A bell that is listening also notices when the other seat's bell is not, while a letter waits
is: A doorbell that also notices when the other seat's bell is dead
did: After one bell died overnight and nothing got done, a running bell now watches the other's heartbeat while a letter waits, and raises the alarm.

title: A note delivered in full never holds the command
is: A fix so a note delivered in full never holds up a command
did: A guard stopped commands over notes already fully handed over, costing retries. Now fully delivered notes pass through, and only cut-off ones still block.

title: A top-level cd into a folder the app knows is refused
